title: Card readers
description: Which Attractap readers may enroll and reset NFC cards. Card keys are created and checked by the server only; this limits where cards can be written.

mode.label: Enroll and reset cards on
mode.description: Readers that are not allowed here still let members sign in with their cards.

all.label: All readers
all.description: Every reader with current firmware can enroll and reset cards.

selected.label: Selected readers
selected.description: Only the readers you pick below can enroll and reset cards.

readers.label: Allowed readers
readers.description: Pick the readers that may write cards.
readers.required: Select at least one reader, or choose all readers.
